title: Direct wastewater RNA capture and purification via the 4S method
author: Oscar N Whitney
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.bpdfmi3n
materials: Prepare 1 L each of two wash buffers - Wash buffer #1 (4S-WB1) and #2 (4S-WB2), for later use during cleanup of RNA bound to silica columns.
Agitate sample to mix ethanol and wastewater lysate.

steps.title: Prepare 4S-WB1 Buffer
steps.instruction: Prepare the 4S-WB1 buffer solution in a sterile bottle.

substeps.instruction: Add 490 mL water.
Add 300 mL of 5 M NaCl.
Add 200 mL of 100% volume Ethanol.
Add 10 mL of 1 M pH 7.2 TRIS.
Agitate to fully mix.

steps.title: Prepare 4S-WB2 Buffer
steps.instruction: Prepare the 4S-WB2 buffer solution in a sterile bottle.

substeps.instruction: Add 170 mL water.
Add 20 mL of 5 M NaCl.
Add 800 mL of 100% volume Ethanol.
Add 10 mL of 1 M pH 7.2 TRIS.
Agitate to fully mix.

steps.title: Prepare Lysis Salt Tubes
steps.instruction: Prepare two sterile 50mL tubes (one for sample, one for matched negative control) containing lysis salts and TE buffer.

substeps.instruction: Add 9.35 g of sodium chloride to each tube.
Prepare pH 7.2 TE buffer (1 M TRIS, 100 mM EDTA).
Add 400 µL of TE buffer to each tube.
Gently shake.

steps.title: Collect and Process Samples
steps.instruction: Add the wastewater sample and the negative control to the pre-salted tubes.

substeps.instruction: Pour a 40 mL wastewater sample into the first pre-salted tube.
Pour 40 mL sterile 1x PBS into the second pre-salted tube.
Agitate both samples until all NaCl dissolves.
Maintain samples at 4 °C during transport to the lab.

steps.title: Spike Process Control
steps.instruction: Add bovine coronavirus (bCoV) or other controls to the wastewater sample.

substeps.instruction: Resuspend dry bCoV stock (Bovilis Coronavirus Calf Vaccine, Merck Animal Health #16445) in 2 mL PBS.
Dilute the resuspended stock 1:10 in PBS (100 µL stock into 900 µL PBS).
Spike 50 µL of diluted bCoV into the wastewater sample.
Agitate to fully mix.

steps.title: Prepare bCoV Quantification Aliquot
steps.instruction: Prepare a control aliquot for accurate concentration assessment.

substeps.instruction: Heat 200 µL of the remaining bCoV spike-in aliquot at 75 °C for 30 minutes.
Freeze for later quantification via RT-qPCR.

steps.title: Heat Inactivate Sample (Recommended)
steps.instruction: Heat inactivate the sample at 70 °C for 45 minutes to potentially improve RNA species enrichment and detection.

steps.title: Filter Sample
steps.instruction: Filter the sample into a sterile 100mL tube using a 5-µm PVDF filter (e.g., Durapore® Membrane Filter 5.0 µm #SVLP04700 with Swinnex Filter Holder #SX0004700 or Pall Magnetic Funnel #4242).

substeps.instruction: Perform filtration via syringe filtration or funnel top vacuum.

steps.title: Add Ethanol to Filtrate
steps.instruction: Add 40 mL of 70% ethanol to the 40 mL of filtrate.

steps.title: Capture RNA via Silica Column
steps.instruction: Pass the lysate through a silica spin column (e.g., Zymo III-P #C1040-5) using a vacuum manifold (e.g., EZ-Vac #S7000).

substeps.instruction: Agitate the wastewater and lysate by inverting the tube five times.
Pour the mixture into the spin column.
Vacuum the full 80 mL of wastewater lysate and ethanol through the column.

steps.title: Wash Silica Column
steps.instruction: Perform sequential washes of the silica spin column.

substeps.instruction: Vacuum 5 mL of 4S-WB1 through the column.
Vacuum 10 mL of 4S-WB2 through the column.

steps.title: Dry Silica Column
steps.instruction: Remove residual wash buffer from the column.

substeps.instruction: Detach the column from the vacuum manifold and remove reservoirs/funnels.
Place the column into a 1.5-mL centrifugation-compatible flowthrough collection tube.
Centrifuge at 10,000 x g, 20 °C, for 2 minutes.

steps.title: Elute RNA
steps.instruction: Elute the purified RNA from the silica column.

substeps.instruction: Discard the previous collection tube and place the column into a new 1.5-mL centrifugation-compatible flowthrough collection tube.
Pre-warm 200 µL of ZymoPURE elution buffer (#D4200-7-30) or pH 8 TE buffer to 50 °C.
Add the 200 µL of pre-warmed elution buffer to the column.
Incubate the assembly at room temperature for 1 minute.
Spin at 10,000 x g, 20 °C, for 5 minutes to elute RNA.

steps.title: Store RNA
steps.instruction: Store the eluted RNA based on intended use.

substeps.instruction: Store at 4 °C for same-day use.
Freeze at -80 °C for long-term storage.
